mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u.real_name AS customer_name, u.phone AS customer_phone FROM booking b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON b.user_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE booking SET status = #{toStatus} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking (booking_no, user_id, venue_id, venue_name, venue_address, booking_date, start_time, end_time, duration_hours, remark, status, source, fee_amount, payment_status) VALUES (#{bookingNo}, #{userId}, #{venueId}, #{venueName}, #{venueAddress}, #{bookingDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationHours}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{source}, #{feeAmount}, #{paymentStatus})
